module: Minimap displayed in ImGui (API marked experimental by BeamNG). It draws into a texture the roads, the player, the other vehicles, the compass, the playmode markers, etc., in a circle or rectangle shape (setting `minimapMode`). Another module activates it with setDrawTransform (position and size relative to the screen, between 0 and 1) and hides it with hide. Every frame, it emits the hook `onDrawOnMinimap(td)` so that other extensions draw on top. Also contains a debug settings window (profiling, garbage measurement, display options).
notes: The file states: "This API is experimental and may change".

`M.onUpdate` is nil on load: setDrawTransform hooks it to the drawing function and calls `extensions.hookUpdate("onUpdate")`; hide resets it to nil. The minimap therefore draws nothing until setDrawTransform has been called.
setDrawTransform and setOcclusionTransform expect normalized values between 0 and 1; otherwise a warning is logged (setDrawTransform then hides the minimap, setOcclusionTransform ignores the zone).
The mode read from the settings is forced to "rect" if it is neither "circle" nor "rect".

Probable BUG: minimap.lua uses `ui_apps_sdfTopomap` (lines 311-312 and 605) while the 0.40.5 topography module is called `ui_apps_minimap_topomap`; this name is defined nowhere, so the contour lines are not drawn.
Settings used: minimapMode, minimapOrientation ("rotateWithCamera"), minimapDrawGrid ("always"), minimapLookahead (disabled/low/medium/high).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: topomap, additionalInfo, route, utils, roads, vehicles of the minimap, and gameplay_playmodeMarkers.

onUpdate.desc: nil at start; set by setDrawTransform (drawing function), reset to nil by hide.

onInit.desc: Called on extension initialization. Switches to manual unload and reads the minimap settings.

onMinimapSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the minimap settings change. Rereads the mode, orientation, grid and lookahead and the state of the ImGui viewports.

setBuffers.desc: Sets custom margins around the minimap (left, right, top, bottom). A nil value becomes 10.

setDrawTransform.desc: Positions the minimap and activates it (hooks onUpdate). The 4 values must be between 0 and 1, otherwise a warning and a call to hide.

setOcclusionTransform.desc: Declares a zone that masks part of the minimap (for example an interface element placed over it). Ignored with a warning if a value is outside 0..1.

resetOcclusionTransform.desc: Removes the occlusion zone with this id; if the id is not a non-empty string, removes all zones.

id.desc: Zone identifier, or nil to clear everything.

drawOcclusion.desc: Draws the occlusion masks and the circular or rectangular cropping of the minimap into the texture. Called by the minimap's drawing loop.

drawDebugOverlay.desc: Draws debug markers (corners, margins) and displays the sizes in ImGui.

hide.desc: Hides the minimap: resets the transform to 0 and unhooks onUpdate.

toggledebugSettings.desc: Opens or closes the debug settings window.

getDebugSettingsData.desc: Returns the choice lists of the debug window (`lookaheadValue`, `profileEveryNthFrame`).

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called at the start of a mission/level. Hides the minimap and resets the roads (`ui_apps_minimap_roads.reset`).

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a mission/level. Hides the minimap and resets the roads.
